svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.paper-clip-object-profile", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Introduce an actual bent-wire paper clip and trace its continuous nested-loop route before matching this enlarged diagram. One open path makes three semicircular turns and four straight tracks, with two open ends and no crossings. The single raised centreline represents the wire, rather than drawing two borders for its thickness. This selected upright orientation is not a new object meaning or an exact product-size template. Do not infer attachment mechanics, safety or learner recognition from the diagram; physical matching and touch proofreading remain pending.", "geometry_exception": "Native Index dots follow polygon boundaries with4mm near-corner guards, or sample the continuous paper-clip route atapproximately3.5mm arc-length pitch. Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm centrelines. This is not exact source worksheet reproduction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending"}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots on logical boundaries/wire route, not Braille. Fourmm polygon corner guards and uniform approximately3.5mm paper-clip path sampling are explicit medium alternatives. Physical continuity remains pending.
